releases.name: Scroll Reverser build 20620 -- v2.0 candidate 1
releases.body: This is a beta leading towards Scroll Reverser 2.0. It is a major update aiming to solve common pain points of the 1.x versions, whilst remaining simple and easy to use. I never expected when I created this app 15 years ago that I'd still be updating it in 2026, but here we are! What's new: - **A setting for each device.** Each trackpad, mouse or other input device now has its own individual setting so you can set each one exactly how you like it. Devices appear in Settings › Scrolling the first time you use them. - **More reliable and more efficient.** Scroll Reverser no longer detects a trackpad by counting the fingers touching it via gesture events. Instead, it reads device information directly. This was a frequent source of unreliability in previous versions. - **Only needs Accessibility permission.** Input Monitoring permission is no longer required. - **Better support for remote input devices.** Scrolling sources such as Universal Control and Screen Sharing each get their own setting, letting you tweak your setup more precisely than before. _After upgrading from 1.x, please check your individual devices in Settings › Scrolling._
